quiet.title: The quiet car
quiet.prompt: Interior of a weathered luxurious 1970s Ethiopian railway passenger carriage seen down the central aisle at eye level, teal painted panelled walls, walnut and brass fittings, oxblood leather bench seats with small tables, warm amber practical lamps, large windows on both sides showing ochre highland mountains in late golden sunlight, dust in the light, a few honeybees in the air, heavy 35mm film grain, technicolor-sepia, cinematic wide shot, no people

dining.title: The prestige train that feels wrong
dining.prompt: Film still from a lost 1970s Ethiopian western-noir shot on scratched 35mm: technicolor-sepia dust, imperial gold, teal and indigo shadow, blood red accents, heavy grain, heat shimmer, documentary patience. Deep-focus wide-angle composition with strong depth. Interior of an elegant but weathered railway dining carriage seen down the central aisle at eye level: white linen tables with brass lamps and coffee cups along both window walls, teal panelled walls, walnut and brass trim, oxblood leather chairs, arched cream ceiling with amber dome lamps. A few strangely still passengers in 1970s suits and shawls sit at the tables, backs mostly to camera, a violinist stands at the far end. Large windows show ochre highland mountains at golden hour. A few honeybees drift over the tables.
